# Kyoto Family Trip at a Relaxed Pace

A 4-day plan for 2 adults and 1 child, built around short transit hops, low-walk sightseeing, and a total activity budget of **JPY 90,000** excluding flights and hotel.

## 4-Day Kyoto Plan Within JPY 90,000

| Day | Focus | Main Stops | Est. Activity Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Apr 10 | Easy arrival + Gion | Check-in, Yasaka Shrine area, Maruyama Park, early dinner | JPY 14,000 |
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=| Apr 10 | Easy arrival + Gion | Check-in, Yasaka Shrine area, Maruyama Park, early dinner | JPY 14,000 |, Kyoto, Japan
| Apr 11 | Kid-friendly east Kyoto | Kyoto City Zoo, Heian Shrine, Kyoto National Museum area | JPY 22,000 |
| Apr 12 | Arashiyama day | Bamboo Grove, Togetsukyo Bridge, monkey park or river stroll | JPY 24,000 |
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/ed/Back_outside_this_is_the_Togetsukyo_Bridge_or_moon_crossing_bridge_%2848743510701%29.jpg Alt=| Apr 12 | Arashiyama day | Bamboo Grove, Togetsukyo Bridge, monkey park or river stroll | JPY 24,000 |, Kyoto, Japan
| Apr 13 | Rainy-day flexible day | Kyoto Railway Museum or aquarium-style backup, shopping, dessert stop | JPY 18,000 |
| Apr 14 | Departure morning | Short breakfast walk, souvenir stop, airport transfer | JPY 12,000 |

## Day-by-Day Family Schedule

### Day 1: Gentle Arrival and Gion Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive in Kyoto, check in, rest, and keep the first day light.
- Afternoon: Slow walk around **Yasaka Shrine** and **Maruyama Park**; stay close to the hotel area to avoid overwalking.
- Dinner: Family-friendly Kyoto set meal near Gion or Higashiyama.
- Walking target: **Under 90 minutes total**.

### Day 2: Kid-Friendly East Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kyoto City Zoo** for an easy, child-friendly start.
- Afternoon: Move to **Heian Shrine** and the nearby gardens for a calmer second stop.
- Dinner: Casual noodle or curry dinner in central Kyoto.
- Walking target: **About 1.5 to 2 hours total**, with taxi or bus between stops.

### Day 3: Arashiyama Outdoors, Kept Light
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** before it gets crowded.
- Afternoon: Choose one main add-on only: **Iwatayama Monkey Park** if your child enjoys animals, or a relaxed **Togetsukyo Bridge** and riverside break if you want less climbing.
- Dinner: Return to central Kyoto for an easy dinner near the hotel.
- Walking target: **About 2 hours total** if you skip the steep monkey park climb; more if you include it.

### Day 4: Rainy-Day Backup and Easy Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-rain.svg
- Morning: Use the weather-safe backup: **Kyoto Railway Museum** for a strong family option with indoor exhibits and child appeal.
- Afternoon: Keep the rest flexible with souvenir shopping at Kyoto Station or a café break.
- Dinner: If departing late, have an early final meal before transfer.
- Walking target: **Under 90 minutes total**.

## Budget Plan for Activities

| Category | Planned Spend | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Entry fees | JPY 28,000 | Zoo, museum, optional monkey park, shrine donations |
| Local transport | JPY 18,000 | Bus, subway, and a few short taxi rides to reduce walking |
| Meals/snacks | JPY 24,000 | Family lunches, snacks, dessert stops, simple dinners |
| Rainy-day backup | JPY 10,000 | Indoor attraction plus café time |
| Souvenirs/misc. | JPY 10,000 | Small family purchases and buffer |
| Total | **JPY 90,000** | Stays within your cap |

## Best Family Picks and Backup Choice

### Kyoto City Zoo
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/emoji-smile.svg
- Strong kid-friendly anchor for Day 2.
- Easy to combine with nearby cultural stops.
- Good for a slower pace and shorter attention span.

### Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Scenic, iconic, and manageable if visited early.
- Pair with only one extra activity to keep the day relaxed.
- Best outdoor day if the weather is clear.

### Kyoto Railway Museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Best rainy-day backup.
- Indoor, interactive, and family-friendly.
- Works well when you want a low-walk day.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Kyoto Tourism] https://kyoto.travel/en

## Sources
- Kyoto City Zoo: https://kyotocityzoo.jp/
- Kyoto Railway Museum: https://www.kyotorailwaymuseum.jp/en/
- Kyoto official tourism guide: https://kyoto.travel/en
